Partner Investment Management Lp decreased its stake in Cigna Corporation (CI) by 33.37% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Partner Investment Management Lp sold 3,159 shares as the company’s stock declined 18.61% with the market. The institutional investor held 6,307 shares of the medical specialities company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $1.28 million, down from 9,466 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Partner Investment Management Lp who had been investing in Cigna Corporation for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $42.87 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.10% or $0.18 during the last trading session, reaching $176.24. About 278,331 shares traded. Cigna Corporation (NYSE:CI) has risen 13.35% since May 16, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 1.80% the S&P500.
